scenes.head: 珍惜每一口
scenes.say: 減少食物浪費，不需要很困難。從眼前這一餐飯開始，我們就能一起做到。
scenes.veo: Gentle shot of a clean empty plate with chopsticks resting on it after a finished meal, warm light.

scenes.head: 吃多少，點多少
scenes.say: 第一個習慣，吃多少，點多少。點餐前，先想想自己今天的食量。
scenes.veo: A customer thoughtfully looking at a menu board at a food counter, pondering, natural light.

scenes.head: 吃不完，打包帶走
scenes.say: 第二個習慣，吃不完就打包帶走，記得在兩小時內放進冰箱冷藏。
scenes.veo: Hands packing leftover food neatly into a reusable container and closing the lid.

scenes.head: 自備餐具與環保杯
scenes.say: 第三個習慣，外帶時自備餐具和環保杯，少用一次性用品。
scenes.veo: A person pulling a reusable cutlery set and a stainless tumbler from a tote bag at a takeaway counter.

scenes.head: 做好分類回收
scenes.say: 第四個習慣，用完餐後，請依照現場標示，把廚餘、資源回收和一般垃圾分開。
scenes.veo: Clean sorting station with three bins, a person dropping a paper cup into the recycling bin.

scenes.head: 廚房端：我們這樣做
scenes.say: 在廚房裡，我們也用先進先出、精準分裝和期限管理，減少食材因為過期而被丟棄。
scenes.veo: Kitchen staff organizing ingredients by date on shelves, measured portions in containers, orderly and calm.

scenes.head: 智慧提醒
scenes.say: 導入智慧品保標籤後，即將到期的食材可以更早被提醒，讓食材在期限內被妥善使用。
scenes.veo: A touchscreen terminal in a kitchen showing a gentle alert glow, staff member checking and nodding.

scenes.head: 每個人少浪費一點
scenes.say: 每個人少浪費一點點，累積起來，就是很大的改變。
scenes.veo: Montage of many different hands each placing a reusable cup on a long table, uplifting mood.

scenes.head: 一起做到
scenes.say: 吃多少點多少，吃不完打包，自備餐具，做好分類。四個小習慣，一起做到。
scenes.veo: Sunlit green leaves gently moving in the breeze with soft bokeh, calm and hopeful.

scenes.head: 品富餐飲
scenes.say: 品富餐飲，珍惜每一口，謝謝你和我們一起行動。
scenes.veo: Warm final shot of a smiling counter staff member handing a meal to a customer who holds a reusable bag.
